ammonia.reason: NH3 from amino-acid deamination by Brevibacterium linens/Arthrobacter drives deacidification pH 5 to ~7

animal_barnyard.reason: p-cresol, m-cresol and indole from tyrosine/tryptophan catabolism by red-smear flora

bitter.reason: Hydrophobic peptides from chymosin/plasmin proteolysis partly trimmed by smear peptidases

blue_moldy.reason: No Penicillium roqueforti inoculation; 2-heptanone/2-nonanone/2-undecanone not reported

browning.reason: Maillard between free amino acids and residual galactose/lactose on heating

buttery.reason: Low diacetyl/acetoin from lactococcal citrate fermentation, masked by smear acids/sulfur

cheesy_sweaty.reason: High branched acids: isobutyric 633ppm, 2-methylbutanoic 163ppm, 3-methylbutanoic 130ppm plus butanoic 139ppm from Val/Leu/Ile catabolism and lipolysis

creaminess.reason: 52.8% moisture with 40% FDM plus smear proteolysis softening to smooth creamy paste

crumbliness.reason: High moisture rennet gel with extensive surface proteolysis gives pliable non-fracturing body

firmness.reason: Soft washed-rind paste at 52.8% moisture, much softer than semi-hard/hard cheeses

floral_honey.reason: 2-phenylethanol/phenylacetaldehyde from phenylalanine catabolism plus p-cresol detected

fruity.reason: 10 ethyl esters from esterification of ethanol with acids by Debaryomyces/Brevibacterium

goaty.reason: 4-methyloctanoic/4-ethyloctanoic not detected in cow-milk soft cheese; hexanoic only 139ppm

malty_nutty.reason: 3-methylbutanal/2-methylbutanal from leucine/isoleucine Strecker degradation, qualitative only

melt.reason: Rennet-coagulated high-moisture pH-neutralized casein network flows readily on heating

mushroom_earthy.reason: 1-octen-3-ol from linoleic acid oxidation and smear metabolism, lower than bloomy rinds

oil_off.reason: Moderate 19.9% fat with free decanoic 705ppm/dodecanoic 600ppm from lipolysis promotes oiling

smoky.reason: Unsmoked; guaiacol and phenolic smoke compounds not reported

sour_vinegar.reason: Very high acetic acid 1968ppm plus propanoic 947ppm from lactate metabolism and smear deacidification

stretch.reason: No hot-water kneading/stretching; rennet curd without aligned paracasein fibers

sulfur_cooked.reason: Methanethiol/dimethyl disulfide/trisulfide from methionine gamma-lyase in B. linens

sweet.reason: Most lactose fermented leaving ~1.8% carbohydrate; slight sweetness from glycerol and Ala/Gly

umami.reason: Glutamate release from rennet/plasmin plus intense Brevibacterium proteolysis
